header.title: Earth & Geospatial Data Scientist | AI-Based Early Warning System Developer

about_me: Earth & Geospatial Data Scientist serving as a lead researcher and primary developer of an Al-driven multi-hazard early warning system integrated with Impact-Based Forecasting (IBF). Experienced in integrating big geospatial data, remote sensing, and earth system numerical models to generate risk-based predictions (hazard-exposure-vulnerability) at a national scale. The developed system has been adopted by BMKG and serves as an operational reference for Disaster Management Agency Sulawesi Selatan, as well as cross-sector stakeholders including local governments and Millitary. It has been implemented in South Sulawesi, Central Java, and Southwest Papua, with ongoing expansion toward Eastern Indonesia. Focused on transforming complex, multi-source data into actionable risk intelligence to support decision-making.

projects.nama: BF AI InaFLEWS - Flood & Landslide Early Warning System (OPERATIONAL)
details: Developed an Al-driven impact-based forecasting system for flood and landslide risk prediction (3-day to monthly climate outlook)
Integrated hazard, exposure, and vulnerability using big geospatial data
Adopted by BMKG as an operational reference

projects.nama: IBF SNORDIV MARISO - Marine Tourism Safety Outlook (OPERATIONAL)
details: Developed a national-scale forecasting system for snorkeling and diving safety and comfort risk index
Generated 14-day forecasts based on ocean-atmosphere interactions

projects.nama: IBF HELIOS - Heat Extreme Level Indicator Forecast System
details: Developed a multi-parameter atmospheric risk model for extreme heat impacts
Produced indicators for heat stroke (feels-like temperature), heat stress (WBGT), dehydration risk, and drinking water needs

projects.nama: IBF SWAF - Severe Wind Advisory Forecast
details: Developed a risk-based forecasting system for strong wind impacts
Modeled impacts such as fallen trees and vessel capsizing using exposure and vulnerability analysis

projects.nama: IBF COWS - Coastal Outlook Warning System
details: Developed a coastal risk prediction system (tidal flooding, storm surge, coastal erosion)
Integrated ocean-atmosphere dynamics into an early warning framework

projects.nama: IBF TCSI - Tropical Cyclone Suitability Index
details: Developed a predictive model for tropical cyclone potential up to 6 months in advance
Applied advanced seasonal forecasting approaches across the ASEAN region

projects.nama: IBF AI SIPPUNG - Tornado Impact Potential System
details: Developed a forecasting system for tornadoes, waterspouts, and severe local vortices up to 7 days ahead

projects.nama: IBF SEMERU - Mountain Risk Early Warning System
details: Developed a predictive system for mountaineering risks, including hypothermia, with forecasts up to 14 days ahead

Cloud-based big geospatial data processing using Google Earth Engine through Python programming
Multi Satellite image processing using ENVI for environmental parameter extraction
Raster and vector modeling with Python-based GIS (PythonGIS) and empirical geospatial methods
programming_data_science: Data processing and analysis using Python (NumPy, Pandas, Xarray, GeoPandas, Scikit-learn, etc.) for analytics and predictive system development
Statistical and spatial analysis using R programming
Scientific computing and numerical modeling using MATLAB
Implementation of Machine Learning (supervised and unsupervised) for geospatial modeling
Application of Computer Vision for remote sensing interpretation and spatial validation
Large-scale geospatial data processing using SQL queries (national-scale datasets)
numerical_modeling: Weather simulation using WRF for atmospheric prediction
Spatial statistical modeling (Ensemble Kalman Filter, EOF, Fourier, Wavelet, etc.)
Hydrological modeling using HEC-RAS and HEC-HMS for flood analysis
Coastal and ocean modeling using Delft3D and MIKE 21
Development of multi-hazard risk models based on Impact-Based Forecasting (IBF)
